heading_path: Communication and Media Studies Major Credit Requirement

entries.text: Complete 72 semester hours in the major.
No more than 2 grades below a “C” in COMM or MSCR courses may be used to satisfy degree requirements.

college: College of Arts, Media and Design
overview_text: The Department of Communication Studies offers majors in both communication studies and in media and screen studies. This integrated major allows students to combine COMM and MSCR courses to create a unique plan of study that features courses on the theory and practice of communication along with the study of media, cultural, and creative industries. Students graduating with a communication and media studies major can pursue a graduate degree or enter careers in advertising, communication education, healthcare, journalism, law, public relations, government/politics, media and film production, and social and human services.
